observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox One X console with a black controller on top, placed on a red tufted couch. The console has a visible 'X' logo on the front right.
Photo 1 shows the same console from a different angle, with a black controller in front of it. The console appears to be the same model as in photo 0.
Both photos show a watermark 'LOVE FOR GADGET' across the image.
The console in both photos appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage.
The controller in photo 0 is black and standard Xbox design; in photo 1, it is black with a gold-colored button on the back, possibly a custom or special edition.
The seller claims '2 units of Xbox One X with One Controller each and batteries'.

identity.kind: Xbox One X console with one controller and batteries

claims.evidence: Only one console is visible in both photos. No second unit is shown.
One controller is visible in photo 0 and photo 1, matching the description.
No batteries are visible in either photo. The claim cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.proof: Photo showing both consoles together or a second unit clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as only one console, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Controllers are not functional or are missing batteries
risks.proof: Video or photo showing both controllers powered on, connected, and responding to inputs, and batteries included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as controllers not working or without batteries, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Consoles are not genuine Xbox One X or are refurbished/repainted
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the console's serial number or model label, and a video showing the console booting up and displaying the Xbox dashboard.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially counterfeit or non-genuine, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo showing both consoles together to confirm two units are included.
Video or photo showing both controllers powered on and connected, with batteries included.
Close-up photo of the console's serial number or model label.
Video showing the console booting up and displaying the Xbox dashboard.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
